commit_message: Add local material interface type needed to express the target virtual call.
Track README progress updater in tools
Add virtual-call helper declaration needed by StrmPlayer::Update matching attempt.
Add the virtual interface for fn_80228AEC's final update dispatch.
Keep vector input accesses observable so the compiler stores the target stack scratch before using it.
Move fn_801660C0 prototype before fn_80166A24 so its call has a visible declaration.
Add a private inline queue-capacity helper for fn_80060CC0 so its checked ring-buffer path can compile as local control flow.
Add the in place basis transform helper used by fn_8001A1F4
Remove redundant memcpy prototype that conflicts with MWCC builtin
Mark lbl_8055B88C as a small-data symbol so fn_80224D40 uses its required SDA relocation.
Declare the shared float used by fn_802795E8
Keep fn_801195D8's declaration unprototyped so the two call sites can match their distinct argument setup.
Give ReadPlayerInfo its real three-argument ABI while retaining the existing one-argument thunk call.
Prevent fn_8013472C from inlining into fn_8013477C
Restore pragmas after fn_802DA550 so following allocator functions keep their own settings.
Try the target's invalid-target instruction scheduling for fn_802917C0.
Use an explicit address dereference in fn_802ABE58 for lbl_80558DC4.
Scope invalid_target scheduling to fn_802E1BB4 to test target register and branch scheduling.
Correct fn_8012850C prototype to match the two arguments passed by fn_802A42C8
Rewrite fn_8005F248 to match target's buf offsets, double copy order, and queue index wrap logic
Add types.h and the globals fn_802CCB84 uses
Restore original SWAP16_AT and SWAP32_AT macros
Name __two_exp's .rodata table of power-of-two digit strings (alias, the label itself can't be renamed yet) and document its offsets
Declare the SD device context and its command constants above fn_800BB4E0, which reads the card through them (the later copy is guarded out).
Stop the Zero alias from leaking past __ieee754_fmod, the only user
Add the conn_flags bits of stack/hid/hid_conn.h and the device state values so hidh_l2cif_config_cfm can name them
Describe nw4hbm::ut::FontCodeMap (the font code map FindGlyphIndex reads) with its three map types, from the offsets FindGlyphIndex/GetGlyph/SetAlternateChar use.
Drop the VF_TYPES_MOVED flag now that only one copy of the types exists.
The two FSInfo fields are passed by address, so name them as pointers (taking the address of a value form costs an extra live register)
Name the second OSContext.state bit that SelectThread and OSLoadContext test
Document the two globals fn_8013126C uses: lbl_8032B328 is its panic message and fn_802E317C is the panic/exit reporter matched in src/game/abend.c.
Add CollisionGroupObj virtual-call layout used by fn_80182DF4
Document the float constants fn_80144BD8 and the matrix/trig helpers use; they are plain .sdata2 literals.
Blank line between fn_801F9CF8 and the following extern prototype, as the rest of the file does.
